searchText: Hi, I've tried the https://4844-devnet-6.ethpandaops.io/, and I can send normal transactions, but does anyone know what is api url of beacon chain to download the blobs? In devnet 5, it is http://xxx:5052/eth/v1/beacon/blobs/head, so wonder what is it on devnet6 We don’t offer a public beacon API. Only authenticated access. oh, thanks for the reply. so if I understand right, the only way to access the beacon API is to setup our own node, join devnet 6 and sync with other node, right? Right, but I would hold off. As currently we have pre-devnet-6 up, and we should be launching devnet-6 this week. It’s not really a network for the public just yet, as we still have lots of tiny iterations Thanks for the update! I've followed this guide(https://hackmd.io/@jimmygchen/H1XUtBIfn) to setup our devnet5 node. Will there be a similar guide for the community to setup a devnet-6 node once the devnet-6 is ready for public join? yea, we'll have some basic documentation up but expect rough edges at this stage sure, thanks! Hey! We are close to finalizing the devnet-6 changes for all our 4844 tests!! The v0.2.5 release will fail almost all tests now as the tx format is ssz so best to wait for the new release. It will be ready soon after we can validate the new tests can be consumed 🧪 🛠️ Currently they can't be consumed due to genesis related issues, as we have dataGasUsed/excessDataGas in the genesis block header but we are working on a workaround swiftly! Great, thanks! I think the only open question on this new release is whether we should assume 2/4 blobs or 3/6, to match devnets <timbeiko> > <timbeiko> replying to: ```@testing4844_bot wrote: <Mario Vega> [reply]: I think the only open question on this new release is whether we should assume 2/4 blobs or 3/6, to match devnets``` I'd lean 3/6 given we've already updated the EIP + other specs?

excerpts.author: 0x_qz
excerpts.content: Hi, I've tried the https://4844-devnet-6.ethpandaops.io/, and I can send normal transactions, but does anyone know what is api url of beacon chain to download the blobs? In devnet 5, it is http://xxx:5052/eth/v1/beacon/blobs/head, so wonder what is it on devnet6

excerpts.author: barnabasbusa
excerpts.content: We don’t offer a public beacon API. Only authenticated access.

excerpts.author: 0x_qz
excerpts.content: oh, thanks for the reply. so if I understand right, the only way to access the beacon API is to setup our own node, join devnet 6 and sync with other node, right?

excerpts.author: barnabasbusa
excerpts.content: Right, but I would hold off. As currently we have pre-devnet-6 up, and we should be launching devnet-6 this week.

excerpts.author: barnabasbusa
excerpts.content: It’s not really a network for the public just yet, as we still have lots of tiny iterations

excerpts.author: 0x_qz
excerpts.content: Thanks for the update! I've followed this guide(https://hackmd.io/@jimmygchen/H1XUtBIfn) to setup our devnet5 node. Will there be a similar guide for the community to setup a devnet-6 node once the devnet-6 is ready for public join?

excerpts.author: parithosh
excerpts.content: yea, we'll have some basic documentation up but expect rough edges at this stage

excerpts.author: spencer_tb
excerpts.content:
Hey! We are close to finalizing the devnet-6 changes for all our 4844 tests!! The v0.2.5 release will fail almost all tests now as the tx format is ssz so best to wait for the new release. It will be ready soon after we can validate the new tests can be consumed  🧪 🛠️ 

Currently they can't be consumed due to genesis related issues, as we have dataGasUsed/excessDataGas in the genesis block header but we are working on a workaround swiftly!

excerpts.author: marioevz
excerpts.content: I think the only open question on this new release is whether we should assume 2/4 blobs or 3/6, to match devnets
